# Introduction
Why (catalog incompleteness, esp. remote terrain / high latitude) and how
(seismoacoustic coupling of thunder). <!-- WS5 -->

# Data
PNWML labeled classes (WS1); station + infrasound inventory (WS2); open lightning
catalogs GLM/ALDN/WWLLN (WS3).

# Method
Spectrogram CNN; seismic-only (Model A) and seismic+infrasound (Model B);
MC-dropout + deep-ensemble uncertainty with calibration (WS4).

# Results
Per-class signal characterization; PNW→OK generalization; completeness gain vs
open lightning catalogs (WS4).

# Discussion
Limitations (open-catalog detection efficiency, domain shift, Alaska coverage).
